dialog_add_stream.reason: Configures one stream channel being added, not a standing app-wide preference.

dialog_scheduled_operation.reason: Configures one scheduled copy/move job, not a standing app-wide preference.

dialog_filter_resource.reason: Configures the sort/filter for the current browse session, not a persisted app-wide preference.

page_welcome_enhanced.reason: Onboarding-wizard page; whether the reference should document wizard copy or only the settings-screen equivalent is a product decision, deferred (S1313 INDEX Pre-Implementation Blockers).

page_welcome_functionality.reason: Onboarding-wizard page; same deferred product decision as page_welcome_enhanced.

page_welcome_networks.reason: Onboarding-wizard page; same deferred product decision as page_welcome_enhanced.

fragment_vr_settings_block.reason: Lives in app_v2/src/vr/res/layout/, so R.layout.fragment_vr_settings_block does not resolve in the standardDebug variant the manifest test runs under.

dialog_playback_control.reason: In-player quick-controls panel (volume/balance/brightness/hue/speed/mute/section-tab buttons); its one plausible setting (switchVrOverrideFormatType, a stereo-mode override) is session-scoped in the player ViewModel per an existing code comment. Not a settings surface.

dialog_slideshow_settings.reason: Hosts one recognized persisted toggle (cbPlayToEnd) but its primary setting (playback interval) is a Slider widget LayoutSettingsSearchSource.kindFromTag does not recognize; cataloging now would document an incomplete, misleading subset. Revisit once Slider/CheckBox widget kinds are supported.
